notes: One general CLI solver must handle five sub-problems (optimal sliding-tile search with A*, parity-based solvability, canonical zero-padded serialization, seven-pairs/thirteen-orphans win detection, four-in-a-row threat blocking, and shortest-turn maze routing under a budget). Difficulty comes from the optimal-move-search core (A*/BFS optimality over 3x3..4x4 boards), the exact-matching turn-budget/ground-truth requirements, and a broad set of adversarial/malformed inputs the hidden cases probe; all of this lands the total in the medium bucket.
